name: Avio Smart Market Stack Limited
summary: Bartronics India Limited specializes in delivering advanced automatic identification and data capture (AIDC) technologies, catering to clients both domestically in India and across international markets. The company's comprehensive product suite includes various smart card types—such as memory, cryptographic, GSM, contactless, biometric, and national identity cards—along with radio frequency identification (RFID) systems and enterprise mobility solutions. They also play a significant role in e-governance initiatives, implementing projects like financial inclusion, public distribution, pilgrim administration, health insurance, and smart card-based driving licenses and vehicle registration. Beyond these, Bartronics offers sophisticated track-and-trace systems for items such as MRO tools, weapons, vehicles, surgical equipment, patients, and documents, alongside infant protection/monitoring and animal identification technologies. Their management solutions extend to warehouses, fleets, inventory, assets, libraries, visitors, contract labor, and pilgrims. Furthermore, they provide essential time and attendance as well as access control systems. On the services front, Bartronics delivers a wide array of IT offerings. These encompass application management (covering modernization, operations, support, middleware, and database services), application development, and enterprise solutions that integrate Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Enterprise Application Integration (EAI), Business Process Management (BPM), Business Intelligence (BI), Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA), enterprise portals, content management, and enterprise mobility. Their IT infrastructure management capabilities include data center operations, end-user computing, network and security management, remote infrastructure services, and IT service desk support. Strategic sourcing services complete their extensive service portfolio. The company's clientele spans diverse sectors, including banking and finance, education, government, healthcare, law enforcement and public safety, manufacturing, telecommunications, transport and logistics, and aerospace. Founded in 1990 as Super Bartronics Limited, the company adopted its current name, Bartronics India Limited, in January 1996 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.

summary: GRP Limited manufactures and sells a range of rubber products including automotive tires and tubes, conveyor belts, and other industrial rubber goods. The company caters to both domestic and international markets, focusing on quality and innovation in the rubber industry; its headquarter is in Kolkata, India. The company operates in the rubber industry with a focus on manufacturing and marketing a wide range of rubber products.

name: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & En
summary: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Ltd. is an Indian shipbuilding company that constructs and repairs commercial and naval vessels. They also manufacture a range of engineering products. The company is headquartered in Kolkata, India, and serves both domestic and international clients.

name: Garware Hi-Tech Films Limited
summary: Garware Hi-Tech Films Limited is a Mumbai-headquartered holding company founded in 1933 by Bhalchandra Digamber Garware. It makes polyester films, including coated label, thermal lamination, BOPP and BOPET products, and reports in India, China and rest-of-world geographic segments.

name: G.S. Auto International Limited
summary: G.S. Auto International Limited is an Indian manufacturer and supplier of automotive components, including leaf springs, U-bolts, and other suspension parts. The company serves the automotive industry, both original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and the aftermarket. G.S. Auto International is headquartered in Ludhiana, Punjab, India.

name: Coffers Finvest Limited
summary: GSB Finance Ltd. engages in the provision of financial services in India. It offers equity trading, derivatives, advisory services, mutual funds, and insurance. The company was founded on November 29, 1982, and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

name: Gujarat Sidhee Cement Limited
summary: Gujarat Sidhee Cement Limited is an Indian cement manufacturer producing Ordinary Portland Cement (OPC) and Portland Pozzolana Cement (PPC). The company serves the construction industry in India. Gujarat Sidhee Cement Limited is headquartered in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.

name: Gujarat State Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited
summary: Gujarat State Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited manufactures and sells fertilizers and industrial products in India. The company offers industrial products, such as anhydrous ammonia, argon gas, caprolactam, melamine, methanol, methyl ethyl ketoxime, nylon-6 chips, oleum, sulphuric acid, acetone cyanohydrine, anone-anol mixture, cyclohexane, cyclohexanone, hydroxylamine sulphate, methacrylic acid, methyl methacrylate, nitric acid, nylon-6 filament yarns, polymethyl methacrylate, GUJCON CRF and PRF polyamide-6 fibres, and technical grade urea. Gujarat State Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited was founded in 1962 and is based in Vadodara, India.

name: GSL Securities Limited
summary: GSL Securities Limited is an Indian financial services company. The company provides stock broking and investment services. It is based in India.

name: Global Surfaces Limited
summary: Global Surfaces Limited mines, produces and trades natural stone and engineered quartz internationally. Its natural stones include granite, marble, soft quartzite, phyllite and soapstone, while its engineered quartz lines include Stratum, Prismatic, Lampros, Kalmasa and Aurora. The company was established in 1991.

summary: Gujarat State Petronet Limited transmits natural gas through pipeline on an open access basis from supply points to demand centers in India. The company develops energy transportation infrastructure and connects natural gas supply sources, including LNG terminals to various markets. It also operates city gas distribution and trading of natural gas business, as well as generates electricity through windmills. The company transports natural gas to various customers, including refineries, steel plants, fertilizer plants, petrochemical plants, power plants, glass, textiles, chemical, city gas distribution (CGD) companies, and other industries in various segments. Gujarat State Petronet Limited was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Gandhinagar, India.

summary: GSS Infotech Limited is an IT services and solutions company based in India, providing services such as remote infrastructure management, cloud services, cybersecurity, and digital solutions. The company's business model focuses on delivering IT solutions to enterprises to optimize their IT infrastructure, improve efficiency, and reduce costs. GSS Infotech is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.

name: GlobalSpace Technologies Limited
summary: GlobalSpace Technologies Limited is an Indian technology company that provides digital workspace solutions, including meeting room booking systems, desk management software, and collaboration tools. The company's business model revolves around offering software-as-a-service (SaaS) solutions to enterprises to optimize their workspace utilization and improve employee productivity. GlobalSpace Technologies is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

name: G-Tech Info-Training Limited
summary: G-Tech Info-Training Limited provides IT and IT-related training services. The company is based in India.

name: GTL Limited
summary: GTL Limited is an Indian telecom infrastructure provider, offering network services and solutions to telecom operators. The company's business model involves building, owning, and operating telecom towers and providing related services, such as tower sharing and managed services. GTL Limited is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

summary: GTL Infrastructure Limited is an independent telecom tower company in India, providing shared passive telecom infrastructure to mobile network operators. The company's business model involves owning and operating a portfolio of telecom towers and leasing space on these towers to multiple operators, allowing them to reduce their infrastructure costs. GTL Infrastructure is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

summary: GTPL Hathway Limited is a cable TV and broadband service provider in India, offering digital cable TV, high-speed broadband, and value-added services to residential and commercial customers. The company's business model revolves around providing entertainment and internet connectivity solutions through its cable and broadband networks. GTPL Hathway is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.

name: GTT Data Solutions Limited
summary: GTT Data Solutions Limited, founded in 1986 and headquartered in Pune, India, offers specialized services globally and within India to the manufacturing, industrial products, and medical devices technology sectors. The company’s primary objective is to facilitate the development and construction of new products, optimize processes, and build essential infrastructure for these industries. Its operations are structured into two distinct segments: IT Services and Training. The IT Services division provides a wide array of AI solutions and digital engineering expertise, including strategic consulting, digital transformation initiatives, data engineering, advanced analytics, enterprise-level AI implementation, DevOps/IT service management, comprehensive ERP/CRM solutions, and various managed or outsourced services. Additionally, it promotes human-digital collaboration, develops leadership capabilities for the AI era, drives organizational culture change, and prepares talent with dual intelligence readiness. The company was formerly known as Cinerad Communications Limited, officially changing its name to GTT Data Solutions Limited in January 2025.

name: GTV Engineering Limited
summary: GTV Engineering Limited is an engineering company in India. They provide engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services for various industries. The company is based in India.

name: Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited
summary: Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited manufactures and sells chemicals in India. Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited is headquartered in Vadodara, India.

summary: Gujarat Apollo Industries Limited manufactures and sells construction equipment. Their products include stationary concrete batching plants, mobile concrete batching plants, and asphalt drum mix plants. The company is based in Mehsana, India.

summary: Gujchem Distillers India Limited manufactures and sells Indian Made Foreign Liquor (IMFL) and Extra Neutral Alcohol (ENA). summary: Primarily involved in manufacturing drums and various containers, Gujarat Containers Ltd. provides barrels made from mild steel and plastic. This enterprise commenced operations on February 11, 1992, and its central office is located in Vadodara, India.

summary: Based in Surat, India, Gujarat Cotex Limited, established in 1996, primarily operates within the textile fabric trade across the country. The company also undertakes transactions involving land and plots. Prior to its current name, the entity was known as Octagon Industries Limited.

summary: Ashtasidhhi Industries Ltd. operates as a Non-Banking Finance Company (NBFC), primarily focusing on offering financial services, investment solutions, and leasing operations. summary: Gujarat Themis Biosyn Limited manufactures and sells pharmaceutical products in India. The company produces various Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) and intermediates. Gujarat Themis Biosyn Limited is headquartered in Vapi, India.

summary: Gujarat Toolroom Ltd. operates within the real estate industry, specializing in the construction of residential properties. summary: Gulf Oil Lubricants India Limited manufactures and markets lubricants in India. The company offers a range of automotive and industrial lubricants, greases, and other related products. Gulf Oil Lubricants India Limited is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

summary: GV Films Limited produces, processes, and edits films in India. summary: GVK Power & Infrastructure Limited is an Indian infrastructure conglomerate with interests in energy, airports, transportation, and resources. summary: GE Power India Limited provides services for power generation plants and equipment, including design, procurement, manufacturing, construction, maintenance and servicing in India and internationally. summary: Hathway Cable and Datacom Limited is a cable television service provider and broadband service provider. The company delivers cable television and high-speed internet services to residential and commercial customers. Hathway Cable and Datacom is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

name: National Securities Depository
summary: National Securities Depository Limited (NSDL) is a prominent Indian entity delivering a comprehensive suite of depository and allied financial services. Its operations are structured across three primary divisions: Depository, Database Management Services, and Banking Services. The Depository segment offers crucial support to investors by enabling the dematerialisation, rematerialisation, secure electronic holding, transfer, and pledging of securities. It further streamlines operations for market intermediaries through straight-through processing facilities and empowers companies with e-voting services. Within Database Management Services, NSDL manages several specialized platforms and registries. These include the National Skills Registry for the IT and ITeS industries, the SEZ online system on behalf of the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, and its function as a KYC Registration Agency (KRA) for centralizing Know Your Customer records across the securities market. This segment also oversees operations related to the Repository of Insurance Policies. The Banking Services arm provides a diverse range of financial offerings. It accepts demand deposits, encompassing both savings and current accounts, and facilitates various payment, remittance, and recharge services via its dedicated mobile application. NSDL also issues debit cards for Point-of-Sale, e-commerce, and ATM transactions, supports domestic money transfers through Business Correspondents, and allows investment in mutual funds and insurance via its mobile app. Additionally, it offers bank verification services tailored for corporate brokers. Beyond these core business lines, NSDL provides electronic custody and trade settlement solutions. Its value-added services include the pledging and hypothecation of securities, automated delivery of securities to clearing corporations, distribution of corporate benefits (both cash and non-cash), stock lending facilities, and the dematerialisation of National Savings Certificates (NSC), Kisan Vikas Patras (KVP), and warehouse receipts. The company's digital infrastructure extends to various e-Services. SPEED-e allows demat account holders and clearing members to directly submit instructions online. IDeAS is an internet-based service enabling demat account holders to conveniently access their account balances and transaction histories. STeADY facilitates the electronic delivery of contract notes from brokers to custodians and fund managers. An online interface for depository account validation allows subscribers to verify DP ID, client ID, and PAN details. Lastly, SPICE offers an efficient way to electronically submit instructions based on power of attorney for clients. Established in 1996 and headquartered in Mumbai, India, National Securities Depository Limited was formerly known as NSDL Depository Limited, adopting its current name in January 2013.

It is headquartered in Mumbai, India, and plays a significant role in India's maritime trade. It provides a wide range of services, including transportation of crude oil, petroleum products, bulk carriers, and container services.

name: Scoobee Day Garments (India) L
summary: Scoobee Day Garments (India) Ltd., founded on August 9, 1994, primarily operates in the production and distribution of paper and paper boards. The company's headquarters are located in Ernakulam, India.

name: Scooters India Limited
summary: Scooters India Limited is an Indian automotive company that manufactures and markets electric vehicles and auto components. It was previously known for manufacturing the Lambretta scooter in India. The company is based in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India.

name: Sheetal Cool Products Limited
summary: Sheetal Cool Products Limited manufactures and sells ice cream, frozen desserts, and other food products in India. The company operates through a network of distributors and retailers. It is based in Amreli, Gujarat, India.

name: Suncare Traders Limited
summary: Suncare Traders Ltd. primarily operates in the distribution and sale of construction and interior finishing materials, such as laminates, plywood, and medium-density fiberboard. The company has also expanded its interests into the solar energy sector, channeling investments into power generation through its associated entity, Madhav Power Private Ltd. This enterprise commenced operations on January 22, 1997, and its main office is located in Ahmedabad, India.

name: Som Distilleries & Breweries Limited
summary: Som Distilleries & Breweries Limited is an Indian alcoholic beverage company that manufactures and sells beer, whisky, vodka, rum, and other spirits. The company has a presence across various states in India and also exports to other countries. The company is headquartered in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India.

name: Span Divergent Limited
summary: Span Divergent Limited is involved in trading of textile products. The Company trades in textile cloth, readymade garments and other products. The headquarter location is in Surat, India.

name: Seacoast Shipping Services Ltd.
summary: SEACOAST SHIPPING SERVICES LIM is a shipping company providing coastal shipping services in India. It focuses on transporting goods and cargo along the Indian coastline. The company is listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange.

name: Sealmatic India Limited
summary: Sealmatic India Ltd. is a manufacturer dedicated to the development and production of mechanical seals and associated equipment. Its comprehensive product line includes various types of seals, such as pusher, standard cartridge, elastomer bellows, metal bellows, engineered, split, and gas-lubricated designs. These specialized sealing solutions are deployed across a wide array of demanding sectors, including oil and gas, refining, petrochemical, chemical, pharmaceutical, fertilizer, power generation, mining, pulp and paper, aerospace, and marine applications. The firm commenced operations on December 2, 2009, and is based in Thane, India.

name: Seamec Limited
summary: Seamec Limited is a provider of diving support vessel services and other offshore support services for the oil and gas industry. It operates primarily in India and the Middle East. The company is listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange.

name: Seasons Textiles Limited
summary: Founded by Inderjeet Singh Wadhwa on April 28, 1986, Seasons Textiles Limited, headquartered in Noida, India, specializes in the production, export, and trade of furnishing fabrics. The company also manufactures diverse made-up textile items.

name: Sea TV Network Limited
summary: Sea TV Network Ltd. operates within the media and entertainment industry, delivering satellite-based news and entertainment programming to a vast audience of millions of households. The company's extensive range of offerings boasts advanced features such as high-definition (HD) channels, personal video recording (PVR) functionality, and the utilization of MPEG-4 technology. Furthermore, its platform includes parental lock controls, options for pay-per-channel subscriptions, a comprehensive multi-language system, and on-demand video (VOD) services, complemented by dedicated customer support and numerous other benefits. Sea TV Network Ltd. was established on May 21, 2004, and its main operational base is situated in Agra, India.

name: Secmark Consultancy Limited
summary: SecMark Consultancy Limited, established in 2011 and based in Mumbai, is a subsidiary of Secmark Holdings Private Limited that provides consulting, technology and outsourcing services. It mainly helps financial market participants with regulatory compliance, operations, software development and risk management, and also offers IT infrastructure management, security audits, forensics, legal counsel, HR solutions and specialized software.

name: SecureKloud Technologies Limited
summary: SecureKloud Technologies Limited provides information and technology services in the United States, India, the Middle East, North America, and internationally. The company's solutions include CloudEz, an enterprise cloud management solution; EzIAM, an user life cycle management platform; CloudAuth, a multi-factor authentication-as-a-service for governing enterprise applications; DataEz, a data lake management platform; CloudEzRX, an user life cycle management platform; and CloudEzSecure, a cloud framework that provides security, which surpasses stringent security regulations. Its solutions also comprise multi-domain identity services platform, an on-demand platform that extends the capabilities of existing identity management, SSO, and legacy services; Cassandra-as-a-Service, a combination of integrated consulting and operations to enhance agility; Automaton, a cloud platform to manage security, cost, and performance in cloud; HER, an end-to-end HER services; and EzMFA, a multi-factor authentication solution for enterprise applications. In addition, the company provides cloud transformation, identity access management, Big data, cloud data analytics, managed, and UI/UX services. It serves healthcare and pharma industries. The company was formerly known as 8K Miles Software Services Limited and changed its name to SecureKloud Technologies Limited in January 2021. SecureKloud Technologies Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Chennai, India.

name: SEDEMAC Mechatronics Ltd.
summary: SEDEMAC Mechatronics Limited develops and manufactures control technologies, such as controllers for generators and vehicles. Its products include supervisory and engine controllers for generators and motor controllers for vehicles, as well as electronic fuel injection and integrated starter generator controls for combustion-engine two-wheelers, produced in volume at its own facilities.

name: Shanti Educational Initiatives Limited
summary: Shanti Educational Initiatives Limited focuses on providing educational services and establishing educational institutions in India, offering a range of academic programs. The company aims to deliver quality education and promote holistic development. The company is based in India.

name: Sejal Glass Ltd.
summary: Sejal Glass Limited produces and sells glass with added value in India and internationally, including solar control glass in pyrolytic coated, body tinted, fireban, decor, armor, tone and solid types. Founded in 1991 and based in Mumbai, it was previously called Sezal Glass Limited until March 2014.

name: Saint-Gobain Sekurit India Limited
summary: Saint-Gobain Sekurit India Limited manufactures and distributes automotive glazing products, including windscreens, side windows, and rear windows. The company is based in Pune, India, and is part of the global Saint-Gobain group.

name: Sanathnagar Enterprises Limited
summary: Sanathnagar Enterprises Limited is involved in manufacturing of various industrial products and real estate activities. The company focuses on different lines of business to create value for its stakeholders. The company is based in India.

name: Selan Exploration Technology Limited
summary: Selan Exploration Technology Limited is an Indian company engaged in the exploration and production of crude oil and natural gas. The company's operations include drilling, production, and related services in onshore fields in India. The company is based in India.

name: Sellwin Traders Limited
summary: Sellwin Traders Limited is involved in trading activities, primarily dealing in various commodities and products. The company facilitates the buying and selling of goods, contributing to the supply chain. The company is based in India.

name: Sel Manufacturing Co. Ltd.
summary: Sel Manufacturing Co. Ltd. operates primarily in India as a textile enterprise. Its comprehensive product line features items like knitted clothing, terry bath towels, a variety of knitted and processed fabrics, and different kinds of yarns. The company was established in Ludhiana, India, in 1969.

name: SEL Manufacturing Company Limited
summary: SEL Manufacturing Company Limited, an integrated textile company, engages in the spinning, knitting, and processing of yarns and fabrics in India and internationally. The company offers cotton combed/carded knitting yarns, slub yarns, organic cotton yarns, poly/cotton blends, TFO double yarns, elitwist yarns, compact yarns, polyester/viscose blended yarns, cotton/modal blends, cotton bamboo blends, zero twist yarns, and melange yarns. It also provides terry towels, including beach, bath, kitchen, Christmas, and embroidered/embellished towels, as well as terry made ups; and readymade garments, such as T-shirts, tops, inner wears, night suits, boxers, sweaters, etc. for men and boys, and women and girls, as well as infants, toddlers, and kids. In addition, the company offers knitted fabrics consisting of single jersey, pique, sheer jersey, interlock, waffle, ottoman, flat back rib, yarn dyed striper, mini-jacquard, electronic jacquard, velour, pointel, suede, rib, variegated rib, cotton fleece, and polyester fleece fabrics, as well as knitted garments, processed fabrics, and various kinds of yarn. SEL Manufacturing Company Limited was founded in 1969 and is based in Ludhiana, India.

name: Semac Construction Limited
summary: Semac Construction Ltd., incorporated in 1962 and headquartered in Gurugram, provides design, engineering, procurement, construction and consultancy services for commercial and industrial projects across India. It works as a contractor and engineering consultant in civil, mechanical and process disciplines, covering architectural, structural, MEP and fire suppression systems, together with project management.

name: Sunrise Efficient Marketing Li
summary: Sunrise Efficient Marketing Ltd. provides diverse electrical, mechanical, and automation solutions. Its offerings span components like motors, gearboxes, industrial lubricants, lighting systems, drives, pumps, and electrical panels. Additionally, the company performs thorough motor rewinding services, a process encompassing data recording, removal of damaged windings, steam cleaning and insulation painting of the stator, lacing, curing, and final testing. Established in 2002, the firm is based in Surat, India.

name: Senco Gold Limited
summary: Senco Gold Limited, set up in 1994, with its head office in Kolkata, manufactures and distributes jewellery and precious metal items. Its offerings are led by gold and diamond jewellery, together with silver, platinum and gemstone pieces and fashion jewellery.

name: Senthil Infotek Limited
summary: Senthil Infotek Limited provides IT solutions and services. The company offers software development, system integration, and other technology-related services. The company is based in India.

name: SEPC Limited
summary: SEPC Limited, formerly Shriram EPC Limited, is a Chennai-headquartered engineering and construction firm incorporated in 2000. It delivers turnkey projects in India and abroad, building industrial plants for metals, cement and process industries, water and sewage treatment facilities, and biomass, thermal and wind power plants. It also supplies engineering services for mining and mineral processing.

name: S. E. Power Limited
summary: S. E. Power Limited is involved in the power generation and distribution sector in India. The company focuses on developing and operating power projects. The company is based in India.

name: Sequent Scientific Limited
summary: Sequent Scientific Limited is an Indian integrated pharmaceutical company with a focus on the animal health segment. The company manufactures and markets veterinary pharmaceutical products, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), and formulations. The company is based in India.

name: Sera Investments & Finance India Limited
summary: Sera Investments & Finance India Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in investment and financing activities primarily in India. It provides personal and MSME loans, as well as offers loan against securities. The company was formerly known as Kapashi Commercial Ltd. and changed its name to Sera Investments & Finance India Limited in May 2022. Sera Investments & Finance India Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

name: Servoteach Industries Limited
summary: Servoteach Industries Limited is involved in providing educational support services and solutions. The company offers training programs and educational products to schools and educational institutions. The company is based in India.

name: Seshasayee Paper and Boards Limited
summary: Seshasayee Paper and Boards Limited manufactures paper and paper products. The company produces a range of paper grades, including writing, printing, and packaging paper, catering to various industries. The company is based in India.

name: Swelect Energy Systems Limited
summary: Swelect Energy Systems Limited manufactures and trades in solar modules, mounting structures, transformers, and inverters in India, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through Solar and Solar Related Activities, Foundry Business, and Others segments. It offers mono and multi crystalline solar photovoltaic modules, and building integrated photovoltaic modules; solar inverters; solar water pumps; and hydro panels. The company also engages in iron, steel, and investment casting activities. In addition, it provides stabilizers; energy conservation and audits, design/retrofit sustainable buildings, and LED lighting system; site feasibility analysis; engineering, procurement, and construction contracts; and operation and maintenance services, as well as engages in solar and wind power generation activities. The company was formerly known as Numeric Power Systems Limited and changed its name to Swelect Energy Systems Limited in May 2012. Swelect Energy Systems Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Chennai, India.

name: Setco Automotive Limited
summary: Setco Automotive Limited is an automotive component manufacturer, specializing in clutches for commercial vehicles. The company supplies clutches to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and the aftermarket. The company is based in India.

name: SBI Mutual Fund
summary: The main goal of this investment product is to achieve returns that closely align with the total performance generated by the securities comprising its designated underlying index, acknowledging that minor deviations, known as tracking error, may occur.

name: SETUBANDHAN INFRASTRUCTURE LIM
summary: SETUBANDHAN INFRASTRUCTURE LIM is involved in infrastructure development activities. The company focuses on construction and related projects. The company is based in India.

name: Seven Hill Industries Limited
summary: Seven Hill Industries Limited is involved in various business activities, including manufacturing and trading. The company operates in diverse sectors to cater to market demands. The company is based in India.

name: Seya Industries Limited
summary: Seya Industries Limited is a chemical manufacturing company in India. The company produces various chemicals and intermediates for the pharmaceutical, agrochemical, and other industries. The company is based in India.

name: Sejal Glass Limited
summary: Sejal Glass Limited is involved in processing and trading of glass products. The company provides a range of glass solutions for architectural and automotive applications. The company is based in India.

name: Sheela Foam Limited
summary: Sheela Foam Limited is a manufacturer of flexible polyurethane foam and other related products. The company's products include mattresses, furniture cushioning, and technical foams. The company is based in India.

name: Square Four Projects India Limited
summary: SQUARE FOUR PROJECTS INDIA LIM is involved in construction and real estate development. The company focuses on residential and commercial projects. The company is based in India.

name: Shashwat Furnishing Solutions Ltd.
summary: Shashwat Furnishing Solutions Limited manufactures and supplies furniture and handicrafts in India. The company offers chairs, tables, sofas, beds and storage, cabinets, dining sets, dining tables, stools, wall clocks, garden and outdoor furniture, vintage furniture, mirrors and mirror frames, wooden furniture, industrial furniture, and decorative handicrafts for hotels, restaurants, cafés, canteens, bars, and banquets. It is also involved in importing, exporting, trading, and dealing in agro based products. Shashwat Furnishing Solutions Limited was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Jodhpur, India.

name: SG Finserve Ltd.
summary: SG Finserve Limited is an Indian non-banking financial company offering lending to dealers, retail customers and vendors. It also finances logistics and transportation businesses and provides supply chain funding and term loans. The company began in 1994 with the name Moongipa Securities.

name: Suyog Gurbaxani Funicular Rope
summary: Suyog Gurbaxani Funicular Ropeways Ltd. specializes in the construction and management of funicular ropeway infrastructure. The company was founded on February 11, 2010, by Shivshankar Lature, Rajkumar Gurbaxani, and Omprakash Gurbaxani, and maintains its principal office in Mumbai, India.

name: Synergy Green Industries Limit
summary: Synergy Green Industries Limited is an Indian company that provides comprehensive solutions for the wind energy sector, including manufacturing wind turbine components, offering engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services, and providing operation and maintenance services. The company aims to be a one-stop shop for the wind energy industry. Its headquarters are located in Pune, India.

name: STL Global Limited
summary: STL Global Limited is an Indian company engaged in the business of manufacturing and exporting steel pipes and tubes. The company offers a range of products including galvanized pipes, electric resistance welded (ERW) pipes, and hollow sections. It serves various industries, including construction, infrastructure, and agriculture.

name: SGL Resources Limited
summary: SGL Resources Limited, together with its subsidiary, Jyacad Solutions Private Limited, designs, develops, and sells integrated GIS and image processing software solutions in India. The company offers IGiS-GIS & IP desktop, a cartographic and visualization tool for conceptualization, production, dissemination, and analysis of 2D and 3D maps; and IGiS - GIS & IP Enterprise Suite, a geospatial suite to create, analyze, manage, and share geospatial data through the Internet and intranet. It also provides IGiS-Photogrammetry suite, an automated geodesy and photogrammetry tool to process stereo imagery captured from various satellites, aircraft, and drones with and without camera information; IGiS CAD, a tool for various 2D and 3D GIS data conversion and digitization; IGiS 3D Pruthvi, an end-to-end 3D GIS platform for creating, processing, viewing and analysing 3D geospatial data; and IGiSMDMS (metadata management system) to store, manage, publish, register, and distribute geospatial data collation. In addition, the company offers Survery 360, a geo survey solution; and IGiS extensions for network, tracking, 3D, neural network, hyperspectral, terrain, raster GIS, hydrology, and MET GIS analysts. Its products are used in smart city, defence, land records management system, agriculture, tracking platform, urban, forest, law enforcement, and utility applications. SGL Resources Limited was formerly known as Scanpoint Geomatics Limited and changed its name to SGL Resources Limited in November 2024. SGL Resources Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

name: SG Mart Ltd
summary: SG Mart Limited, set up in 1985, with its head office in Noida, trades and processes building materials for domestic and international customers. Its downstream steel products include TMT bars, angles, channels, mesh and binding wires, welding wires, hot rolled coils and steel billets.

name: SGN Telecoms Limited
summary: Based in Mohali, India, SGN Telecoms Ltd. specializes in producing a variety of cable components. Their product lineup features power, XLPE, control, and data cables, in addition to AAAC, AAC, and ACSR conductors, and solar water heaters. The company began its operations on April 16, 1986.

name: Shree Ganesh Remedies Limited
summary: Shree Ganesh Remedies Ltd. operates within the healthcare industry, specializing in the entire process of conceiving, developing, producing, and distributing medical goods. Their portfolio features a variety of items such as pharmaceutical intermediates, finished drugs, animal health products, and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). The company, which was established on April 27, 1995, has its corporate headquarters in Ankleshwar, India.

name: Shadowfax Technologies Limited
summary: Shadowfax Technologies Limited is an Indian logistics company built around technology, handling third-party delivery work. Its offerings range from parcel delivery and return pickups to quick-commerce and hyperlocal on-demand deliveries, mobility and dark store operations. Its enterprise customers include e-commerce, food marketplace and mobility businesses. The company was incorporated in 2015.

name: Shah Metacorp Limited
summary: Shah Metacorp Ltd., established in Ahmedabad in 1999, makes and distributes long products from stainless and mild steel, mainly for India. It has two divisions, Stainless Steel Products and Agricultural Products, and its stainless range includes ingots, flat bars, bright bars and equal angle bars.

name: Shah Alloys Limited
summary: Shah Alloys Limited manufactures and sells flat and long stainless steel, alloy and special steel, carbon/mild steel, and armor steel products in India. It offers hot rolled coils, hot rolled sheets/plates, cold rolled coils and sheets, hot rolled round bars, bright round bars, peeled bars, and hot rolled flat bars, as well as angles, beams, flats, slabs, billets, etc. The company also exports its products to approximately 50 countries. Shah Alloys Limited was founded in 1990 and is based in Gandhinagar, India.

name: Shah Foods Limited
summary: Shah Foods Limited is a company primarily involved in the food processing industry. Its main activities include the manufacturing and distribution of biscuits. The enterprise was established by Janak Shah on March 18, 1982, and its principal office is located in Ahmedabad, India.

name: Shahlon Silk Industries Limite
summary: Shahlon Silk Industries Ltd. specializes in the production of synthetic textile yarns and unfinished fabrics. Their extensive fabric range includes solid-dyed, jacquard, yarn-dyed, printed, and eco-friendly options, as well as greige materials. These versatile textiles are suitable for numerous applications such as weaving, furnishing, making laces and tapes, knitting, velvet production, and labels. Founded in 1984, the company is based in Surat, India.

name: Shaily Engineering Plastics Limited
summary: Shaily Engineering Plastics Limited is a plastic molding company. The company manufactures plastic components for various industries, including automotive, consumer durables, and healthcare. The company is based in India.

name: Shakti Pumps (India) Limited
summary: Shakti Pumps (India) Limited manufactures and sells pumps and motors. The company offers a range of pumps including submersible pumps, solar pumps, and pressure boosting pumps, as well as related services. The company is based in India.

name: Shalby Limited
summary: Shalby Limited operates a chain of hospitals in India. The company provides multi-specialty tertiary healthcare services. Shalby Hospitals is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.

name: Shalimar Wires Industries Limited
summary: Shalimar Wires Industries Limited manufactures paper machine clothing. It supplies fabrics for paper mills in India and internationally. The company is based in India.

name: Shalimar Paints Limited
summary: Shalimar Paints Limited manufactures and sells paints and coatings. The company offers a range of decorative and industrial paints. Shalimar Paints is based in India.

name: Shalimar Productions Limited
summary: Shalimar Productions Ltd. is an active participant in the media and entertainment industry. The company's operations encompass the creation, distribution, and sale of music albums, short films, and feature-length movies, all released under its own Shalimar brand. Founded on March 20, 1985, the firm is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

name: Shamrock Industrial Co. Ltd.
summary: Shamrock Industrial Co. Ltd. specializes in the manufacturing of a broad spectrum of bulk pharmaceutical and chemical commodities. Its product range encompasses active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), sophisticated intermediates, general intermediates, and high-quality fine chemicals. The company, established on July 1, 1991, bases its operations out of its headquarters in Mumbai, India.

name: Shangar Decor Limited
summary: Shangar Decor Limited specializes in a wide array of event styling and design services. Their comprehensive portfolio encompasses event decoration for pre-wedding functions, bespoke themed weddings, corporate gatherings, and religious ceremonies. Additionally, they offer venue and property enhancement, specialized lighting solutions, and culinary catering services. The company commenced operations on November 16, 1995, and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.

name: Shankara Building Products Limited
summary: Shankara Building Products Limited is a retailer of home improvement and building products in India. The company operates a chain of retail stores under the "Shankara Buildpro" brand. Its headquarters are in Bangalore, India.

name: Shankesh Jewellers Limited
summary: Shankesh Jewellers Ltd. is engaged in the business of hand crafted gold jewelry and provides customization services. The company was founded by Kantilal Jain in 1987 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

name: Shantai Industries Limited
summary: Shantai Industries Limited's primary business revolves around the commercial exchange of textile goods. Its activities encompass the global acquisition (importing), international distribution (exporting), and direct sale (retailing) of textile constituents such as fabrics, threads, and raw fibers. The company was founded on April 9, 1985, and operates from its main office in Surat, India.

name: Shanthi Gears Limited
summary: Shanthi Gears Limited designs, manufactures, supplies, and services gears and gear boxes in India, the United States, Europe, and internationally. The company offers standard products, such as helical and bevel helical, worm, extruder, and cooling tower gear boxes, as well as geared motors. It also provides custom built loose gears, which include gears and pinions, and special gearboxes; and iron, as well as phosphor bronze, aluminum bronze, leaded bronze, and copper alloy castings. In addition, the company offers installation support, refurbishment, and on site services. Its products are used in steel, cement, sugar, crane and material handling, paper, power, rubber and plastics, off-highway and mining, process, compressor, railway, textile, and aerospace applications. The company was founded in 1960 and is based in Coimbatore, India. Shanthi Gears Limited is a subsidiary of Tube Investments of India Limited.

name: Shanti Gold International Ltd.
summary: Shanti Gold International Limited, a Mumbai company set up in 2003, designs, makes and wholesales gold jewelry. Its catalog covers bangles, rings, necklaces, pendants and earrings, and its buyers are located across India, the US, Qatar, Singapore and the UAE.

name: Shanti Guru Industries Ltd.
summary: Shanti Guru Industries Ltd., established on September 29, 2010, is headquartered in Chennai, India. The company's core business revolves around the domestic distribution and sale of various food items, including both raw and processed goods.

name: 52 Weeks Entertainment Limited
summary: 52 Weeks Entertainment Limited, headquartered in Mumbai, India, specializes in the development and production of motion pictures and television programming. The company was co-founded by Shantanu Sheorey and Nayantara Katkar Sheorey on June 18, 1993.

name: Sharda Motor Industries Limited
summary: Sharda Motor Industries Limited manufactures and supplies automotive exhaust systems and suspension components. Its products include exhaust mufflers, catalytic converters, and suspension struts. The company is based in India.

name: Sharda Cropchem Limited
summary: Sharda Cropchem Limited is a crop protection chemical company. It manufactures and distributes a wide range of formulations and active ingredients globally. Sharda Cropchem is based in India.

name: Sharda Motor Industries Ltd.
summary: Sharda Motor Industries Limited manufactures, assembles, and sells auto components and white goods components to automobiles and electronics original equipment manufacturers in India. It offers exhaust systems for passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, and tractors; suspensions systems, such as arm lower control comp, arm and axle assy, and rear and front suspensions; and canopies, seat trim and seat assembly, rear seats, front cushion, hinge assly rear back, frame comp rear back, and riser, as well as catalytic converters, seat covers for two wheelers and four wheelers, and pressed part white goods products. The company also exports its products. Sharda Motor Industries Limited was founded in 1986 and is based in New Delhi, India.

name: Shardul Securities Limited
summary: Shardul Securities Ltd. functions as an investment banking entity, offering a broad spectrum of financial services. Its primary undertakings involve capital deployment in instruments such as equities and debt, participation in merchant banking, and providing funding for Initial Public Offerings (IPOs). The company further delivers financial advisory and brokerage services. Established on July 23, 1985, its main operations are based in Mumbai, India.

name: Share India Securities Limited
summary: Share India Securities Limited, a financial services company, trades in securities. The company offers broking/depository services, including equity, derivative, commodity, currency, mutual funds, and depository services; loan against securities, loan against commodities, business loans, and personal loans, as well as short, medium, and long term financial loans; and life and general insurances for individual and corporates. It also provides qualified institutional placements; bulk and block trades on exchanges; off-market transactions; arranges private equity; valuation advisory; open offers, buyback, and delisting of securities; and equity mobilization services for infrastructure projects from private equity investors, as well as manages initial public offerings and rights offering. In addition, the company offers a range of financial products and personalized services, including currency and commodity derivative, depository participant, research and analysis, mutual fund advisory and distributorship, and portfolio management services. It serves customers through a network of approximately 587 branches across 14 states in India. The company was formerly known as FMS Securities Limited and changed its name to Share India Securities Limited in 2010. Share India Securities Limited was founded in 1994 and is based in Delhi, India.

name: Sharika Enterprises Limited
summary: Sharika Enterprises Ltd. is a holding company. The firm engages in the provision of consultancy services. Its services include site survey, design and engineering, procurement, engineering procurement and construction, and performance analysis. The company was founded on May 6, 1998 and is headquartered in Noida, India.

name: Sharp India Limited
summary: Sharp India Limited markets and sells consumer electronics and business solutions. It offers products such as televisions, refrigerators, air conditioners, and photocopiers. Sharp India is a subsidiary of Sharp Corporation, Japan.

name: Sharp Investments Limited
summary: Sharp Investments Limited operates as a non-banking financial services provider, offering credit facilities and opportunities for equity investments. The company was founded on November 28, 1977, by Dibakar Chatterjee, Madan Chand Jain, and Birdhi Chand Jain, and its corporate headquarters are located in Kolkata, India.

name: Sharpline Broadcast Limited
summary: Sharpline Broadcast Ltd. engages in the business of providing advertising services on all mass media such as radio, television, newspaper, magazine printed publicity, and exhibition outdoor publicity. The company was founded on June 24, 1999 and is headquartered in Delhi, India.

name: Shashijit Infraprojects Limited
summary: Shashijit Infraprojects Ltd. undertakes the construction and advancement of diverse projects, spanning critical infrastructure, private driveways, public utility networks, power facilities, industrial factories, and various fixed real estate properties. Its operations are organized into two primary divisions: the development of immovable private assets and engagement in governmental infrastructure works. Founded in 1991, the company's main office is situated in Vapi, India.

name: Narmada Gelatines Limited
summary: Narmada Gelatines Limited manufactures and sells gelatin products. It caters to the pharmaceutical, food, and photographic industries. The company is based in India.

name: Shri Bajrang Alliance Limited
summary: Shri Bajrang Alliance Limited manufactures and sells structural steel products in India. The company operates in two segments, Steel and Agro. The company offers structural steel products, including angles, channels, joists, beams, rounds, flats, and H-beams. It also provides ready to eat frozen food products, as well as extracts oils and oleoresin essential oils. The company also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Shri Bajrang Alloys Limited and changed its name to Shri Bajrang Alliance Limited in December 2019. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Raipur, India.

name: Shivalik Bimetal Controls Limited
summary: Shivalik Bimetal Controls Limited manufactures bimetal/tri-metal strips and parts. Its products are used in electrical, automotive and industrial applications. The company is based in India.

name: Shelter Pharma Limited
summary: Shelter Pharma Ltd. engages in the manufacturing and sale of herbal products with a presence in Human Pharma as well as Veterinary space. The company was founded by Mustaqim Nisarahmed Sabugar on October 12, 2007 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.

name: Shemaroo Entertainment Limited
summary: Shemaroo Entertainment Limited is an Indian content house engaged in content ownership, aggregation and distribution. The company operates across multiple platforms, including television, digital and mobile entertainment. Shemaroo is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

name: Shervani Industrial Syndicate Limited
summary: Shervani Industrial Syndicate Ltd. primarily operates in the property development sector and constructs infrastructure facilities. Notable projects within its portfolio include Naman Homes, Victory Tower, and Tara Towers. The firm was established on February 25, 1948, and its corporate headquarters are situated in Allahabad, India.

name: Sheshadri Industries Limited
summary: Sheshadri Industries Limited is primarily involved in the production of textiles. Its diverse product range encompasses cotton, blended polyester, and polyester viscose, in addition to various blended yarns, ready-to-wear apparel, and specialized medical textiles. Founded by B. N. Agarwal on August 26, 2009, the company maintains its main office in Secunderabad, India.

name: Shetron Limited
summary: Shetron Limited, established on June 9, 1980, operates from its headquarters in Mumbai, India, focusing on the production of diverse metal packaging solutions. summary: Zuari Agro Chemicals Limited is an Indian fertilizer company that manufactures and markets a range of fertilizers, including nitrogenous and phosphatic fertilizers. The company also produces seeds and provides agri-inputs to farmers. Zuari Agro Chemicals is part of the Adventz Group.

name: Zuari Global Limited
summary: Zuari Global Limited is an Indian conglomerate with diversified interests in various sectors, including engineering, lifestyle products, and real estate. The company operates through its subsidiaries and associate companies. Zuari Global is part of the Adventz Group.

name: Zuari Industries Limited
summary: Zuari Industries Limited is a diversified Indian group established in 1967 and headquartered in Gurugram. Formerly Zuari Global Limited, it has used its present name since June 2022, and its activities cover services, lifestyle products, infrastructure development, heavy engineering and agriculture, organised into eight segments.

name: Welcast Steels Limited
summary: Welcast Steels Limited is engaged in the production and sale of chrome grinding media balls. These essential products are utilized extensively within the cement, mining, and thermal power plant sectors. The company was established in Ahmedabad, India, on February 28, 1972, where its headquarters remain.

name: Zydus Lifesciences Limited
summary: Zydus Lifesciences Limited, founded in Ahmedabad in 1952 as Cadila Healthcare Limited and renamed in February 2022, is an Indian pharmaceutical and consumer goods company operating globally. It covers research, manufacturing, marketing and distribution of medicines, selling in India, the United States, Europe, Latin America, Asia Pacific and Africa.

name: Zydus Wellness Limited
summary: Zydus Wellness Limited is a consumer wellness company that manufactures and markets health and nutrition products. The company offers a range of products, including sugar substitutes, skin care products, and nutritional supplements. Zydus Wellness is based in Ahmedabad, India.
